summary.text: Shannon Zimmerman is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 30, who took office on January 3, 2017, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Kevin Knoke.

paragraphs.text: Shannon Zimmerman won Assembly District 30 general elections in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, according to Ballotpedia.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Finance Committee and the Joint Finance Committee.
